class.name: GDKResult
class.brief_description: Normalized result object for GDK async operations.

method.name: is_ok
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the operation completed successfully.

method.name: get_hresult
method.description: Returns the underlying Win32 [code]HRESULT[/code] value for the result.

method.name: get_code
method.description: Returns the stable machine-readable error code (for example [code]already_initialized[/code]).

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns optional payload data attached to the result.
